scenarios.name: rambling-info-question

history.content: Um... hi, I was wondering... uh... what... what are your hours like? Sorry, I know I'm rambling.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Signal 3 fires — model scans the full hesitant turn, finds the embedded 'hours' question, routes to info_pivot. Does NOT fall through to FALLBACK ROUTING or UNCLEAR INTENT.

scenarios.name: rambling-deeply-embedded-effectiveness-question

history.content: Yeah, um, I've been having some back pain and I talked to my GP and she said maybe physio would help but I'm not sure and I was just wondering... do you... um... do you even do that kind of thing here?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Signal 3 fires — effectiveness question buried in a hesitant multi-clause turn. Model routes to info_pivot, NOT UNCLEAR INTENT. RAMBLING clause causes it to scan the entire message for the embedded question.

scenarios.name: third-party-booking-payload-value

history.content: I'd like to book an appointment for my daughter Sarah

scenarios.expected_behavior: Signal 1 fires with book_intent. Payload includes booking_for='other' (correct backend enum — NOT 'someone_else'), family_member_name='Sarah'.

scenarios.name: transfer-request-contact-clinic-not-ai-redirect

history.content: Hi, you've reached Totally Well in Robina. I'm Mia, the AI receptionist. I can help you book, reschedule, or choose the right appointment — how can I help you today?
Could you transfer to a team member, please?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Must NOT fire AI CAPABILITY REDIRECT. Must fire TRANSFER TO CLINIC rule: say "Sure, no problem. I'll transfer you now." and call transfer_to_number. HALT.

scenarios.name: MISSED CALL — CONTACT CLINIC fires, offers to pass message

history.content: Hi, you've reached Shire Osteopath. I'm Jane, AI receptionist. How can I help you today?
I missed a call from this number.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: CONTACT CLINIC fires (from system prompt) — agent speaks 'I'm not able to transfer your call to reception, but I can pass on a message for them to call you back.' (or very close equivalent) with ZERO tool call this turn. FAIL if: agent calls any tool; FAIL if: agent says 'That's outside what I can help with'; FAIL if: agent says 'Thanks for calling back! What can I help you with today?'; FAIL if: agent asks 'Would you like to book an appointment?'.

history.content: Hi, you've reached Shire Osteopath. I'm Jane, AI receptionist. How can I help you today?

I can help with osteopathy bookings and questions. Was there something specific you wanted to ask about your appointment or our services?
